_meta.purpose: Appendix I -- the developmental ORDER grammar. WHY promoter stiffness gamma does NOT predict Carnegie staging, and WHAT does: the regulatory-cascade hierarchy depth (a HIGHER-ORDER / G3 architecture grammar), composited with the local barrier. ADD-ONLY: Appendices A-H and every prior number/grade/equation/DOI are unchanged.
_meta.rule: LOCK -> Derive -> Gate. No fitted parameters. precision != accuracy. cascade edges are CITED [F] modelling choices; Carnegie onset ranks are CITED [L] anatomy; never tuned.
_meta.the_axes: STAGING ORDER (predicted by the cascade grammar: [V] mechanism + [L] empirical) ; ABSOLUTE TIMING in days (OPEN [O], never claimed).

grades.[L]: locked: real GRCh38 driver-gene gamma (inherited byte-identical) / cited regulatory edges / cited Carnegie-stage onset order
grades.[V]: verified: exact logical invariant -- the cascade is a DAG, toposort gives a deterministic order, the coupled-R19 firing order respects the partial order, the resort levers, determinism
grades.[F]: fixed modelling choice (the specific regulatory edge set; the coupled-network drive form and uniform weights); declared and cited
grades.[O]: open: absolute developmental TIME in days/Carnegie-duration, and READING the full cis-regulatory wiring from sequence ALONE, are not claimed -- back-fit forbidden

spinodal_form.provenance: re-used verbatim from Appendix A emergence engine (code/emergence_v2); the gamma->onset map.

barrier_form.provenance: cusp-catastrophe barrier height of the R19 switch ds/dt=gamma*s - s^3 + h; re-used verbatim from the VP substrate (Appendix A geometry).

value.drive_form: ds_i/dt = gamma_i*s_i - s_i^3 + h_i ;  h_i = h_base + Wsum_i ;  Wsum_i = W * sum_j( edge[j->i] * sigmoid(s_j) )  + ramp(t)*[i is a SOURCE]
value.sigmoid: g(s) = 1/(1+exp(-k*(s - s_on))) ; k=8.0 ; s_on=0.5  (declared, not fitted)
value.ramp: ramp(t) = r*t , r=0.02 ; applied ONLY to cascade SOURCE nodes (the global developmental input that drives the top of the hierarchy)
value.init_state: s_i(0) = -sqrt(gamma_i)  (the OFF / low branch of the R19 cusp; ON is +sqrt(gamma))

coupled_network.provenance: the coupled-R19 reaction network. Weights are UNIFORM (W=1) and the ramp/sigmoid are DECLARED single values -- chosen so baseline drive alone keeps every switch OFF (sub-spinodal), so the ONLY route to ON is an ON upstream parent. Under that (stated) condition the firing order is FORCED to respect the DAG partial order -- a theorem, not a fit. No per-gene parameter is tuned.

carnegie_rank_corr_ceiling.provenance: the locked NULL ceiling: |Spearman(predictor, Carnegie onset rank)| at/below this counts as 'does not predict staging' (parallel to Appendix A's measured null and Appendix H's count-null ceiling 0.30).

cascade_corr_floor.provenance: the locked DISCOVERY floor: Spearman(cascade depth, Carnegie onset rank) must exceed this AND strictly exceed the gamma correlation for the higher-order grammar to count as predictive. Declared before measurement.
cascade_corr_floor.status_after_measurement: PRE-REGISTERED TARGET, NOT MET GLOBALLY. Measured Spearman(cascade depth, Carnegie rank) = 0.475 over all 22 anchored genes (< 0.70) and 0.639 over the main wired component. The target is met ONLY along the linear axial dependency chain (organizer->clock->somite->sclerotome->chondro->ossification). Therefore the ABSOLUTE rank-strength claim is graded [L] (moderate, scope-limited), NOT [V]. The dilution is concentrated in NAMED kit-coverage gaps (limb-bud genes are artificial cascade sources because their FGF/Wnt inducers are absent from the 38-gene kit; the HOX kit is group-13-only with no HOX1-12 collinear chain). This honest partial negative is reported, not hidden (반증=발견).

edge_concordance_floor.provenance: the locked DISCOVERY gate: among cited regulatory edges parent->child whose BOTH endpoints carry a Carnegie onset rank, the fraction with rank(child) >= rank(parent) (ties allowed, counted concordant) must be >= this, i.e. ZERO inversions. This tests the load-bearing claim directly: the cascade WIRING (the G3 architecture grammar) read on the time axis never contradicts the cited temporal order. Declared = 1.0 (no inversion tolerated).

depth_beats_gamma_required.provenance: locked: |Spearman(cascade depth, Carnegie rank)| must STRICTLY exceed |Spearman(spinodal(gamma), Carnegie rank)| on (a) all anchored genes AND (b) the main weakly-connected cascade component. This is the minimal honest 'depth predicts order better than local stiffness' claim, independent of any absolute floor.

regulatory_cascade._axis: G3 architecture/discourse grammar (the cis-regulatory WIRING) read on the TIME axis: parent must be ON before it can deliver drive to child. Toposort depth = emergence order.

regulatory_cascade.sources_note: nodes with no incoming edge are cascade SOURCES (developmental founders) driven by the global ramp: FOXA2(axial/endoderm), OTX2/GBX2(neural), PAX7(myo), TBX4/TBX5(limb), PAX2/GATA4(organ), PITX2/MSX1/MSX2(cranio).
regulatory_cascade.hox13_limitation: the kit holds only group-13 (5') HOX; the anterior cluster genes that would place HOX13 at its true temporal-collinearity DEPTH (posterior-induction terminus) are absent, so cascade depth UNDER-states HOX13 lateness. Named, not hidden; the Carnegie anchor still ranks HOX13 late (autopod CS17).
